_about: Mochiioteca research tasks (List 11 #97). Extends #14 MOCHIIOTECA-COMPLETION without duplicating it: task TALLIES are stored facts in the save's research section; research LEVELS are derived at read time from tallies vs targets and are NEVER stored. No fourth discovery state is added. All task lists, targets, weights and level bands are OPEN owner/game-design content; this fragment fixes the closed kind vocabulary and the record shapes only.

consumers: #14 completion page (milestone kind PROPOSED, contents OPEN)
level_derivation.rule: level(species) computed at read time from tallies vs targets; never written to the save

tally_shape_stored_facts.form: { speciesId: { taskId: count } } — counts increment on the event, written only by the owning source system
tally_shape_stored_facts.save_section: research (registered in #96 payload map at landing)

task_kinds_closed: observe — witness the species in the field (encounter via #7 spawn tables, watched not just triggered)
feed — offer food in field or Garden (care vocabulary #28/#39; item resolves via #31, effect OPEN)
battle-witness — see the species use a move in a living fight (move id via moves registry PR #366; performance variance per #9)
track — read its trace via #89 tracking (footprint_grid / trace kind; covers foot_type: none species)
care — a Garden care act in the individual's careLog (#28)

task_shape.target: OPEN — count at which the task is complete; null until owner/balance pass
